content.text: {"core": "Breakthrough removes a structure that no longer holds. In Transformation, it lands where one thing was already ending on its own — a shape completing its change. Overdone, the breaking arrives before the ending finishes: the slow turn gets shattered mid-turn, and nothing is given time to become the next thing. What was ripening is smashed instead of ripened.", "sheetLine": "It was already turning; the smashing came before the turning could finish."}
